text: The content pack owns six web-distinct rules -- `style` (mechanical): page meta present (title/description/canonical), image alt-text, descriptive link text; `craft` (judgment): scannability, primary CTA, reading-level target -- each schema-valid and enumerated under `--lang content`. The generic prose hygiene (filler, vanity metrics, headings, trope pass) is the shared `IN-PR-*` base, not re-authored here.
